payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over levels: each level's points sorted by x; dp[i][0/1] = min total distance ending at leftmost/rightmost point of level i, with transitions from previous level's ends using Manhattan distances.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D DP table (levels × 2) storing optimal distances reaching the leftmost or rightmost point of each level. Transitions between levels consider all combinations. This is classic dp_2d_state.
